name: mirage
text: v1.0.34 is out: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.34 . It holds the API-quality journal (the engine now saves how fast, fresh and useful each API is after every scan) and the cross-checked CLV columns (clv_consensus, clv_sources, clv_confirmed on every bet in the PropLine CLV dataset). Not yet built: the same CLV check for bids, and the phone/grader keeping every close it fetches; those are the next items (CH57).
